reason: An image and vision utility suite providing OCR, image analysis, local image transformations, screenshot comparison, palette extraction, and allowlisted webpage capture, with optional routing to configured external vision APIs.

summaries.zh: 面向 Windows 的视觉工具套件，提供图片理解、OCR、裁剪、截图差异比较、主色提取和白名单网页截图功能。
summaries.en: A Windows-focused vision toolkit for image understanding, OCR, cropping, screenshot comparison, color extraction, and allowlisted webpage capture.

capabilities: image understanding through configured remote vision providers
OCR using remote providers or local Tesseract
local image cropping, comparison, and color extraction
webpage screenshot capture through an allowlisted local browser
